body.message:
We have two studio options available. One without Burj view at AED 4,500 for 1 month (30 nights), and one with Burj view at AED 5,500 for 1 month (30 nights).

If you would like, we can arrange a viewing so you can decide which option works best for you. Please note there is also a security deposit of AED 2,000.
